proposals.evidence: DEDR1097 gives Kannada kaccu bite and Tamil kaccu gnaw/nibble. Survey kacc-/kats-/kac- bite responses are comparative southern variants retaining the source affricate spelling and ordinary final vowels; the semantic fit is explicitly biting. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
